title: lithocarpus gracilis
intro: Lithocarpus gracilis, commonly known as the Taiwanese copper beech, is a species of flowering plant in the beech family Fagaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lithocarpus gracilis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative, and anti-cancer properties.
